περιτελλομένου: περιτέλλομαι — revolve, come round; pres. part. mid. masc. gen. sg., gen. absolute with ἔτεος: ’as the year came round’
περὶ: περί — around, about; prep. + gen.: ’superior to, beyond’; also as adv.: ’exceedingly, surpassingly’ · also prep. + gen. in its plain sense ’about, concerning’ (περὶ πατρός ’about his father’) · also preverb in tmesis · + dat. · also + acc., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ ἄστυ ’around the city’) · also + gen., of place, physically ’around, encircling’ (περὶ σπείους γλαφυροῖο ’around the hollow cave’), distinct from the comparative ’beyond’ sense above · also + dat. in the fixed idiom περὶ κῆρι ’exceedingly, at heart’ (περὶ κῆρι τιμήσουσιν ’will honor him at heart’) · also + dat., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ χροῒ ’about the skin’) · also adverb of place, no case: ’round about’ (περὶ δ’ ἕρκος ἐλήλαται ’and round it a fence is driven’)
πληγεῖσα: πλήσσω — strike; aor. pass. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’struck’
πλῆτο: πίμπλημι — fill; aor. mid./pass. 3 sg., unaugmented, epic (= Attic ἐπλήσθη): ’was filled’ (+ gen.)
πολεμίζομεν: πολεμίζω — make war, fight; impf. 1 pl., unaugmented (= ἐπολεμίζομεν; the same form is also pres.): ’we were fighting’
πολλά: πολύς — much, many; neut. nom. pl. (agreeing with ἔγχεα): ’many’ · also neut. acc. pl., object of a verb: ’many things’ (παλαιά τε πολλά τε εἰδώς ’knowing many old things’)
πολλή: πολύς — much, many; adj., fem. nom. sg.: ’much, in plenty’
πολλοὶ: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl.
πολλοὺς: πολύς — much, many; masc. acc. pl.
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.: ’many things, greatly’ · also neut. nom. pl., plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. pl. noun (πολλὰ ... δάκρυα ’many tears’) · also neut. acc. pl., plain attributive adj. (κτήματα πολλὰ ’many possessions’) · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’again and again’ (πολλὰ περιτροπέοντες) · also neut. nom. pl. as substantive, subject: οἷά τε πολλὰ γίγνεται ’as many things happen’
πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’by far’ · also neut. nom. sg. adj. agreeing with ὕδωρ: ’much, plentiful’
ποτέ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; encl. adv.
πρὶν: πρίν — before, until; adv./conj., + inf. (grave, mid-clause form) · also τὸ πρίν, substantivized with the article: ‘formerly, at first’, no infinitive · also bare adv. ’formerly’, no art./inf. · also + aor. subj., ’before’ (πρὶν … ἐπέλθῃ ’before it comes upon’) · also + opt.: ’before’ (πρὶν τλαίη ’before he would bring himself’) · also adv. with a finite verb, ’before that, sooner’ (πρὶν … ἀγείρετο ’before that … came gathering’) · also + fut. indic.: ’before’ (πρὶν … γαῖα καθέξει ’before the earth covers’)
πόδεσσιν: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic ποσί)
πόντος: πόντος — sea, open sea; masc. nom. sg.
πότμον: πότμος — fate, doom, death; masc. acc. sg.
πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, functioning as an adverb) — beside, alongside; adv. · also a preposition + acc., ’beside’ (πὰρ Νέστορα) · also preverb in tmesis (πὰρ … θῆκεν = παρέθηκε ’set before’) · also a preposition + dat., ’beside’ (πὰρ πυρί ’beside the fire’)
πᾶσα: πᾶς — all, whole; fem. nom. sg.: ’all over’
πῆμ: πῆμα — woe, calamity; neut. acc. sg., elided (πῆμ’ = πῆμα)
πῆμα: πῆμα — woe, calamity, disaster; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., direct object: ’woe’
σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’ · also σός — your, yours; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (σ’ = σά): τὰ σ’ αὐτοῦ κήδε’ ’your own troubles’
στυγερὴν: στυγερός — hateful, loathsome; adj., fem. acc. sg.
στῆσα: ἵστημι — set, make stand; aor. 1 sg. transitive: ’I brought to a stand, moored’ (νέας ’the ships’)
σφισι: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl. pron. (= Attic αὐτοῖς): ’to/for them’
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also as adverb, ’together’, or as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: σὺν … κάλυψε = συνεκάλυψε ’covered up’; σὺν … ἔπεσον = συνέπεσον ’fell together, clashed’ · also adverb ’along, with (us)’ construed with ἔχοντες, which takes the object (σὺν … χεῖρας ἔχοντες ’having hands along with us’)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’) · also in ἦ τ’ (= ἦ τε), a strengthened affirmation: ’truly, surely’ (ἦ τ’ ἂν πολὺ κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would surely have been far better’) · also after a relative of size or amount, with no connective force: ὅσην τ’ ὄρεος κορυφήν ’as large as a mountain’s peak’
τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.; also relative: ’which’ (accented τά before a following enclitic)
τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, also marks a standing fact (epic τε) · also in the idiom ὅ τε (= ὅτι) ’in that, because’, giving a reason: ὅ τέ με … ἀποβῆναι ἀνώγει ’in that he bids me step off’ · also in ἦ τέ, a strengthened affirmation: ’truly’ (ἦ τέ μ’ ἔφαντο ’who truly said’)
τέκε: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= ἔτεκε)
τήν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg., resumptive: ’whom’ · also demonstrative, fem. acc. sg., resuming an earlier noun: ’her’ (τήν … ῥέξω ’her I will sacrifice’) · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὀιζυῖ πολλῇ, τήν μοι ἐπῶρσε ’great misery, which he roused for me’)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τεκέεσσιν: τέκος — child; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic τέκνοις)
τελεσφόρον: τελεσφόρος — bringing to completion, full (of a year’s cycle); masc. acc. sg.
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’) · also as a substantive object, in a question: ’anything, something’ (ἦ ῥά τι ἴδμεν ’do we know anything’) · also the neut. of τις forming, with a preceding ὅ, the indefinite relative ὅ τι ’whatever, that which’ (αὔδα ὅ τι φρονέεις ’say whatever you have in mind’) · also ὅ τι as an adverbial acc. in an indirect question: ’why’ · also as a substantive object in a statement: ’something’ (καί τι ἴσασι ’they know something’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl.: ’they’; also relative: ’who’
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. pl. (ἀέθλους, τοὺς … ἐπειρήσαντο Ὀδυσῆος ’the contests with which they tried Odysseus’) · also demonstrative with a noun: masc. acc. pl. ’those, the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους … ἑταίρους ’the rest of my companions’)
τοῖος: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; masc. nom. sg. (τοῖος ... οἷον ’such as’)
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. gen. sg. ’of him, that one’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whose, of whom; masc. gen. sg. (τοῦ νῶι θεοῦ ὣς τερπόμεθ’ αὐδῇ ’whose voice we delight in’) · also demonstrative gen. of comparison after a comparative: τοῦ γε κρεῖσσον ’better than this’ · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ: ’from that time’ · also neut. gen. sg., partitive, ’of it’ (τοῦ μὲν ὅσον τ’ ὄργυιαν ’of it, about a fathom’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the’ (τοῦ παιδὸς ’that son’) · also article-like gen. sg. with a noun and a participle (gen. absolute), distributive: ’of the one … of the other’ (τοῦ μὲν φθίνοντος μηνός, τοῦ δ’ ἱσταμένοιο ’as one month wanes and the other begins’)
τράφεν: τρέφω — nourish, rear, bring up; aor. pass. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐτράφησαν): ’were reared, grew up’
τρέφει: τρέφω — nourish, rear, foster; pres. 3 sg. (of Amphitrite fostering sea-creatures) · also of food, ’nourishes, makes thrive’ (τά θ’ ὕεσσι τρέφει τεθαλυῖαν ἀλοιφήν ’which nourishes thriving fat on pigs’)
τροίης: Τροία — Troy; gen. sg. (Ionic -ης for Attic -ας)
τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also in the adverbial idiom τὰ πρῶτα, ’at first, first’ (not ’these things’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’those, the’ (τὰ σὰ γούνατα ’those knees of yours’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: which; neut. nom. pl. (μῆλα, τὰ … κατάκειτ’ ’the flocks, which lie’)
τὰς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. pl.: ‘them, those’ (referring to ships) · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the mules · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the cattle · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the fruits · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the nymphs and of the Sirens · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: fem. acc. pl. ’which’ (ἀπειλάων, τὰς … ἐπηπείλησε ’threats which he threatened’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’) · also demonstrative, distributive: masc. acc. sg. ’the one … the other’ (τὸν μὲν … τὸν δ’) · also article-like with a participle: τὸν ἐόντα ’me, the one who am’ · also article-like with a superlative or ordinal: ’the best’ (τὸν ἄριστον), ’the fourth’ (τὸν τέταρτον)
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these things, of them’ · also with a noun, article-like: τῶν ἄλλων ἀνέμων ’of the other winds’ · also distributive, ’of the one … of the other’ (τῶν μὲν … τῶν δ’ ’of the one band … of the other’)
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc./neut. dat. sg.; also relative: ’in which’ · the relative dat. sg. also serves as an instrumental, ’with which’ (τῷ δάμνησι ’with which she overpowers’) · also adverbial ’therefore, and so’ (τῷ οὔ τινα οἶδα ’so I know no one’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the same’ (ἤματι τῷ αὐτῷ ’on that same day’) · also demonstrative instrumental, of a thing just named: ’with it’ (τῷ ἀπὸ πείσματ’ ἔκοψα ’with it I cut the cables off’) · also demonstrative of a thing just named, before a preposition: ’it’ (τῷ δ’ ἐν ’and on it’, τῷ δ’ ὑπό ’and beneath it’)
υἱάσι: υἱός — son; masc. dat. pl., epic stem υἱ- (= Attic υἱοῖς/υἱέσι)
υἱέες: υἱός — son; masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic υἱεῖς)
υἷας: υἱός — son; masc. acc. pl., epic υἷας (= Attic υἱούς)
υἷες: υἱός — son; masc. nom. pl., epic υἷες (= Attic υἱεῖς)
φίλ: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. voc. sg., elided (φίλ’ = φίλε)
φίλαι: φίλος — dear, beloved; fem. voc. pl., used substantivally: ’friends’ (of the serving-women)
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own (with kin/body parts serves as a possessive); neut. nom./acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masculine noun: φίλον υἱόν ’dear son’ · also masc. acc. sg. predicative, agreeing with a pronoun: ’as a friend, welcome’ (φίλον ἐλθεῖν)
φίλος: φίλος — dear, dear one; masc. nom. sg. used as voc.: ’friend’ · also plain attributive adjective, not vocative: ’dear’ (φίλος υἱός ’dear son’) · also predicate adjective: ’dear’ (φίλος ἦεν Ἰήσων ’Jason was dear (to her)’)
φαίνετο: φαίνω — show; mid. appear, seem; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐφαίνετο)
φαινομένηφιν: φαίνομαι — appear, show oneself; pres. part. (dat. sg. sense) φαινομένηφιν, the rare -φι(ν) suffix, elsewhere confined to nouns, attached here unusually to a participle: ’(Dawn) as she appears’ — a genuinely rare formation
φερόμην: φέρω — carry; impf. pass. 1 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐφερόμην): ’I was carried, I drifted’
φρεσίν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φρεσὶν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
χέοντα: χέω — pour; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., tmesis κατὰ ... χέοντα = καταχέοντα: ’pouring down, shedding’
χαλεπὴ: χαλεπός — hard, grievous; fem. nom. sg., with μοῖρα
χαλκοῦ: χαλκός — bronze, copper; masc. gen. sg.
χείρεσσιν: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν
χλαῖνάν: χλαῖνα — a thick woollen cloak; fem. acc. sg.
χρήματ: χρῆμα — thing, matter; pl. χρήματα ’goods, property’; neut. acc. pl., elided (χρήματ’ = χρήματα)
ἀΐδαο: Ἀΐδης — Hades, god and realm of the dead; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic Ἅιδου)
ἀγήνωρ: ἀγήνωρ — lordly, manly, proud; adj. (2-termination), masc./fem. nom. sg.
ἀγλαὰ: ἀγλαός — splendid, shining, glorious; adj., neut. acc. pl. (ἀγλαὰ δῶρα ’splendid gifts’)
ἀγροὺς: ἀγρός — field, countryside; masc. acc. pl.
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀλόχου: ἄλοχος — wife; fem. gen. sg., with πρός · also fem. gen. sg. as object of πειράω (+ gen.): ’of your wife’ (σῆς ἀλόχου πειρήσεαι ’you will make trial of your wife’)
ἀμφιελίσσας: ἀμφιέλισσα — curved at both ends (standing epithet of ships); fem. acc. pl.
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around, about; prep./adv. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ ... βάλλομεν = ἀμφιβάλλομεν ’we threw around, embraced’)
ἀν: ἀνά (elided ἀν’) — up, along; prep. + acc.: ἀν’ ἰθύν ’in a straight line’ · also + acc., ’throughout, up and down’ (ἀν’ Ἑλλάδα ’throughout Hellas’)
ἀνάγκῃ: ἀνάγκη — necessity, compulsion; dat. sg., dat. of manner: ’under compulsion’
ἀνέμοισιν: ἄνεμος — wind; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ἀνέρος: ἀνήρ — man; masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀνδρός)
ἀνήνασθαι: ἀναίνομαι — refuse, deny, disown; aor. mid. inf.
ἀναβάντες: ἀναβαίνω — go up, go aboard, embark; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having embarked’
ἀναστήσας: ἀνίστημι — make rise, uproot, remove; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having moved (them) out’
ἀνθρώποισιν: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; masc. dat. pl., epic (= Attic -οις)
ἀνθρώπων: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; gen. pl.
ἀντιθέοις: ἀντίθεος — godlike, equal to the gods; adj., masc. dat. pl.
ἀνώγει: ἄνωγα (defective, perf. with pres. force) — command, bid, order; impf. 3 sg., + inf.: ’was bidding’ · also pres. 3 sg., a present formed on the perf. stem: ’bids’ (ἐποτρύνει καὶ ἀνώγει ’urges and bids’)
ἀπατήλια: ἀπατήλιος — deceitful; neut. acc. pl. used as a noun: ’deceits, lies’
ἀποαίνυτο: ἀπαίνυμαι — take away, deprive of; impf. 3 sg. mid., uncontracted, unaugmented (ἀποαίνυτο): ’took away’
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
ἀρετῆς: ἀρετή — excellence, worth (of a person); fem. gen. sg.
ἀχαιούς: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’ · also ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead’ (μή μ’ ἄγε κεῖσ’ ’do not lead me there’)
ἄγον: ἄγω — lead, bring, take along; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγον): ’I took along’
ἄλγεα: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἄλλη: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. nom. sg., adverbial in the idiom ἄλλυδις ἄλλη ’one this way, another that’ · also plain adj., fem. nom. sg.: ’other’ (οὔ τις ... ἄλλη ’no other woman’)
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl.
ἄλλοισίν: ἄλλος — other; adj., masc. dat. pl.: ’to the others’
ἄλλοισιν: ἄλλος — other, another; masc./neut. dat. pl.
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.
ἄμυδις: ἄμυδις — together, at once, in a body; adv.
ἄρης: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. nom. sg.
ἄσπετον: ἄσπετος — unspeakable, vast beyond telling; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ὕδωρ (ἀ- + root of ἔννεπε ’tell’) · also agreeing with οὖδας: ἄσπετον οὖδας ’the vast ground’
ἅμ: ἅμα (elided ἅμ’) — together with, at the same time as; adv./prep. + dat.
ἅπαντες: ἅπας — all, every one; masc. nom. pl.
ἐγένοντο: γίγνομαι — become, happen; aor. 3 pl.: ’became, were’ (ὁμηγερέες ἐγένοντο ’were assembled together’) · also ’were born’ (ἠδ’ ἐγένοντο)
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐλέησεν: ἐλεέω — pity, have compassion on; aor. 3 sg.
ἐλείπομεν: λείπω — leave, quit; impf. 1 pl.: ’we were leaving’
ἐλελίχθη: ἐλελίζω — shake, make quiver; aor. pass. 3 sg.: ’was made to quiver, shook’
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’
ἐμοῖς: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. dat. pl.
ἐμφορέοντο: ἐμφορέω — carry in; pass. be carried about, tossed; impf. 3 pl. pass., epic uncontracted, unaugmented: ’were tossed’
ἐμῆς: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. gen. sg.
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνιαυτόν: ἐνιαυτός — year; acc. sg., accusative of duration: ’for a year’ · also as object of εἰς marking duration: εἰς ἐνιαυτόν ’for a year’
ἐννῆμαρ: ἐννῆμαρ — for nine days; adv. (ἐννέα + ἦμαρ)
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐξετελεῦντο: ἐκτελέω — bring to completion; impf. pass. 3 pl., epic contraction (= Attic ἐξετελοῦντο): ’were completed’
ἐπήλυθον: ἐπέρχομαι — come upon, come on, pass by; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἐπῆλθον)
ἐπήρετμοι: ἐπήρετμος — at the oar, seated ready to row; masc. nom. pl. · also of ships, ’fitted/equipped with oars’: νῆες ἐπήρετμοι ’oared ships’ (masc. nom. pl.)
ἐπελθὼν: ἐπέρχομαι — go to, come upon; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having gone to’
ἐπιβήμεναι: ἐπιβαίνω — step upon, set foot on (+ gen.); aor. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic ἐπιβῆναι)
ἐπιπλόμενον: ἐπιπέλομαι — come round, revolve (of a year); epic aor. part. mid. neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ἔτος
ἐπισπεῖν: ἐφέπω — follow, meet, come upon (+ acc., of fate); aor. inf. ἐπισπεῖν
ἐπισπόμενοι: ἕπομαι — follow; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ‘following’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’) · also adverb of sequence, ’next, thereupon’ (ἦλθε δ’ ἐπὶ ψυχή ’and next came the soul’) · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: ἐπὶ … τέταλτο = ἐπιτέταλτο ’was laid upon, entrusted’ · also + acc. of time: ’for, over’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’)
ἐρίηρας: ἐρίηρος — traditionally ’trusty’, exact sense uncertain (of companions); masc. acc. pl.
ἐρίηρες: ἐρίηρος — trusty, dear (of companions; exact sense uncertain); masc. nom. pl.
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐτίμα: τιμάω — honour; impf. 3 sg., contracted: ’used to honour’
ἐώργει: ἔοργα (perf. of ἔρδω/ῥέζω) — have done, be wont to do; plpf. w/ impf. force, 3 sg.: ’treated, used to treat’
ἐῢ: ἐΰς — good; neut. ἐῢ as adv. ’well’ (= εὖ)
ἑβδομάτῃ: ἑβδόματος — seventh (epic = Attic ἕβδομος); fem. dat. sg., dat. of time, ἡμέρῃ understood: ’on the seventh (day)’
ἑλών: αἱρέω — take, choose; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’picking out, choosing’
ἑξῆμαρ: ἑξῆμαρ — for six days (ἕξ ’six’ + ἦμαρ ’day’); adv.
ἑπτάετες: ἑπτάετες — for seven years; adv. (acc. of duration, ἑπτά + ἔτος)
ἑπόμην: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; impf. 1 sg. mid. (= Attic εἱπόμην): ’I followed’
ἑτάροισι: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); dat. pl., epic -οισι
ἑτάροισιν: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
ἑταίρους: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. acc. pl.
ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form), address: ’companions!’
ἔα: ἐάω — let be, allow, leave alone; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’leave alone!’
ἔβαν: βαίνω — go, walk; aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἔβησαν)
ἔθεεν: θέω — run; impf. 3 sg.: ’was running, sped on’
ἔθηκα: τίθημι — put, place; make (so-and-so); aor. 1 sg. (κ-aorist): ’I made (you dear to)’
ἔθηκεν: τίθημι — put, place; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’placed’
ἔκειτο: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid up, be stored; impf. 3 sg.
ἔλυσε: λύω — loose, undo, untie; aor. 3 sg.; with ἀπό in tmesis (ἀπὸ … ἔλυσε = ἀπέλυσε) ’loosed off’ · also with ὑπό in tmesis (ὑπὸ … ἔλυσε = ὑπέλυσε) ’loosed beneath’, of the knees
ἔμ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (ἔμ’ = ἐμέ): ’me’
ἔμβαλε: ἐμβάλλω — throw into, cast into; aor. 3 sg.
ἔμεινα: μένω — stay, remain, wait; aor. 1 sg.: ’I stayed’
ἔμπης: ἔμπης — nevertheless, in any case, for all that; adv.
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also used relatively, continuing a clause: ’where’ (ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’) · also doubled, ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’this way and that’
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἔργον: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal verb (κακὸν … ἔργον τε ἔπος τε μελέτω ’let no evil deed or word be a care’) · also neut. nom. sg., in apposition/predicative, naming a maker: ἔργον Ἡφαίστοιο ’the work of Hephaestus’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject of a passive verb: ’work’ (τόδε ἔργον ἀέξεται ’this work grows’)
ἔρυκε: ἐρύκω — hold back, detain, keep; impf. 3 sg., no augment · also pres. imper. 2 sg., in a prohibition with μή: μὴ ... ἔρυκε ’do not detain (me)!’
ἔρυσθαι: ἔρυμαι — guard, protect, shelter; epic inf.
ἔσκε: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, iterative: ’used to be, was’
ἔσκεν: εἰμί — be; impf. iterative 3 sg. (-σκε(ν) suffix): ’used to be’
ἔστη: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg. intrans.: ’stood, took his stand’
ἔστησε: ἵστημι — set, set up, station; aor. 3 sg. transitive: ’set (it) up’
ἔτεος: ἔτος — year; neut. gen. sg., epic -εος (= Attic -ους), gen. absolute with περιτελλομένου
ἔτλη: τλάω — bring oneself to, dare, endure; aor. 3 sg. (ἔτλην, inf. τλῆναι)
ἔχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἶχε)
ἕσσεν: ἕννυμι — clothe; aor. 3 sg., epic σσ, ν-movable: ’clothed (me)’
ἠγαγόμην: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. mid. 1 sg., augmented (root’s α lengthens to η): ’I brought home’
ἠμὲν: ἠμέν — both (epic correlative, ἠμέν … ἠδέ ’both … and’); conj.
ἠοῖ: ἠώς — dawn; fem. dat. sg. ἠοῖ
ἡ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. sg.: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a pool of water (ἡ δὲ προσέπλαζε ’and it lapped up’) · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a ship (ἡ δ’ ἔθει ’and it ran’) · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun/adj., article-like: ’the other’ (ἡ δ’ ἄλλη ’and the other woman’) · also fem. nom. sg. article-like with a noun: ’the’ (ἡ γὰρ δμώων δίκη ’for the way of servants’)
ἡγήσασθαι: ἡγέομαι — lead the way, guide; aor. inf. mid.: ’to lead’
ἡμέων: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; gen. pl. ’of us’, epic uncontracted (= Attic ἡμῶν)
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤλυθον: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 1 sg., augmented, epic root ἐλυθ- with epenthetic -υ- (= Attic ἦλθον): ’I have come’ · also aor. 3 pl. (the form serves both persons): ’they came’
ἤνωγον: ἄνωγα — order, bid, urge (perf. with pres. sense); impf. 3 pl. ἤνωγον, epic: ’they urged’
ἤχλυσε: ἀχλύω — grow dark, be misty; aor. 3 sg., augmented ἤ-: ’grew dark’
ἥ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. · also ὁ, ἡ, τό (personal/demonstrative pronoun): she; fem. nom. sg. (ἥ γε ’she indeed’, of the ship)
ἥρως: ἥρως — hero, man of standing; masc. nom. sg. · also used as a vocative in direct address, inserted mid-sentence (ἥρως, εἴρεσθαι δέ ’and ask, hero that you are’), distinct from its use as a narrative title ’the hero’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’) · also ’or’, the second alternative of a pair of questions with no preceding ἠέ: ζώει … ἦ τέθνηκε ’alive or dead’; ἢ ἔτ’ ἔχει … ἦ μιν ἀτιμάζουσιν ’whether … or’
ἦα: εἰμί — be; impf. 1 sg., epic ἦα (= Attic ἦν)
ἦγεν: ἄγω — lead, bring; impf. 3 sg., ν-movable: ’brought, was leading’
ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἦλθεν: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’came’
ἦλθον: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. 3 pl.: ’they came’ · also aor. 1 sg. (the same ending serves both persons): ’I have come’
ἱέμενοι: ἵεμαι — long for, strain toward, be eager; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’longing’ (οἴκαδε ἱέμενοι ’longing for home’)
ἱκόμεσθα: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive; aor. 1 pl. mid., epic -μεσθα (= Attic -μεθα): ’we came’
ἱστὸν: ἱστός — loom, mast; masc. acc. sg. (here ’loom’, and by extension the web on it) · also ’mast’ (of a ship): ἱστὸν … στῆσαν ἀείραντες ’they raised and set up the mast’
ἴθυνον: ἰθύνω — steer straight, guide; impf. 3 pl.: ’they steered’
ἴκελοι: ἴκελος — like, resembling (+ dat.); masc. nom. pl.
ἴλιον: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. acc. sg.
ἵκετ: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented and elided (ἵκετ’ = ἵκετο) · also augmented, with the long ι that the metre needs (ἵκετ’ ἐμὸν δῶ ’came to my house’)
ἵκετο: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg.; where the metre makes the ι long, that is the augment, which the spelling cannot show; with short ι, unaugmented
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; + subj. · also + opt. after a past tense · also relative ’where’ + indic.: ἵνα … καθεύδετον ’where the two are sleeping’
ἶσον: ἴσος — equal, like; neut. nom. sg., with οὔρεϊ: ’equal to a mountain’ · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’equally, as much as’ (ἶσον Ἀχιλλῆος … ἀχνύμεθα ’we grieve as much as for Achilles’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with τόν, + dat.: ’like, equal to’ (ἔρνεϊ ἶσον ’like a sapling’)
ὀΐομαι: ὀΐω — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg. mid., epic ὀΐομαι: ’I think’ (+ acc. and inf.)
ὀλοοῖς: ὀλοός — destructive, deadly; masc. dat. pl.
ὀξέϊ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; masc. dat. sg., epic ὀξέϊ (= Attic ὀξεῖ)
ὀπίσσω: ὀπίσσω — behind; in Homer also ’hereafter, in time to come’; adv. · also ’back, home again’, of return (οἴκαδ’ ὀπίσσω ’back home’)
ὁδὸν: ὁδός — way, journey; fem. acc. sg.
ὁπότε: ὁπότε — whenever, when; temporal conj., + opt. in a general/iterative clause
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄλεθρον: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin, death; acc. sg.
ὄφελον: ὀφείλω — owe; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (Attic ὤφελον), with an infinitive, an unattainable wish: ’would that...’
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἔτι κεῖνος ἀνὴρ ἐπιδήμιος ἦεν ’as long as that man was still at home’) · also ’while’ + ἄν and subj. · also temporal ’until’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἵκετ’ Ἀρήτην ’until he came to Arete’) · also ’until’ + ἄν and subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἵκηαι ’until you reach’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary verb: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ … μένοιεν) · also temporal ’until’ + opt., of a hoped-for event (ὄφρ’ ἐξεμέσειεν ’until she should vomit out’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη) · also = ὅτι ’that’; εἰς ὅ ’until’ · also relative, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὅ οἱ πέρι δῶκεν Ἀθήνη ’which Athena gave her beyond others’) · also masc. nom. sg. pronoun ’he’ without γε, accented before an enclitic (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’)
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
ὅπως: ὅπως — so that, in order that, how; + subj. or fut. indic. · also + opt., in secondary sequence after a past-tense verb, indirect deliberative: ’how it might’ (ὅπως ἄριστα γένοιτο ’how it might turn out best’) · also ’when’ = ὅτε · also ’as, however’ + subj. in a general clause: ὅπως ἐθέλῃσιν ’however he wishes’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might follow’ (ὅπως … ἑποίατο) · also + pres. indic., ’as, in whatever way’ (ὅπως ἐθέλεις ’as you wish’)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also with τις, an indirect interrogative: οὐκ οἶδ’ ὅς τις ’I know not who’ · also with τις, indefinite relative: ὅς τις … φάγοι ’whoever should eat’
ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’) · also with the optative, hypothetical/conditional: ’if ever, whenever’ (ὅτε ... ἵκοι ’if ever such need should come upon me’) · also with the subjunctive, general: ’whenever’ (ὅτε στείχῃσ’ ἀνὰ ἄστυ ’whenever she goes through the town’) · also with the optative, iterative in past time: ’whenever’ (ὅτε μέλλοι ’whenever he was about to’) · also with the pres. indic., ’whereas, when’ (ὅτε τ’ ἄλλοι ἅπαξ θνῄσκουσ’ ἄνθρωποι ’whereas other men die only once’)
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; prep. + gen.; also + acc., ’under, up under’ · also of agent with a verb of dying, ‘by, at the hands of’ + gen. (ὤλεθ’ ὑπ’ Αἰγίσθοιο ‘perished by Aegisthus’) · also + dat., ’under, beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb, no case governed: οὓς ὑπ’ Ὀδυσσεὺς δύσετ’ = ὑπεδύσετο ’underneath which Odysseus sank down’
ὑπέδεκτο: ὑποδέχομαι — undertake, promise, agree to; aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented · also ’receive as a host, welcome’ (ὅττι μιν ὣς ὑπέδεκτο ’that he had received him so’)
ὑπέρθυμοι: ὑπέρθυμος — high-spirited, high-hearted; masc. nom. pl.
ὑπὲρ: ὑπέρ — over, beyond; + acc. (ὑπὲρ μόρον ’beyond one’s portion’) · also + gen., literally ’over, above’ (ὑπὲρ ἀργυρέοιο λέβητος ’over a silver basin’)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; prep. + dat./acc.; also used as an adverb, ’beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis (ὑπὸ … ἐδήσατο = ὑπεδήσατο ’bound beneath’) · also adverbial, of breeding: ’begotten under, born of’ (ὑπὸ δ’ ἡμίονοι ’and under them [the mares], mules’) · also + dat., marking the agent with a passive verb: ’by’ (ὑπὸ μνηστῆρσιν δαμείη ’be overcome by the suitors’) · also + gen., ’from under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο) · also + gen., marking agent with a passive verb/participle beyond dying, ’by’: μεγάλου ὑπὸ κύματος ἀρθείς ’lifted up by a great wave’ · also + gen., of cause: ὑπὸ ῥιπῆς ’at the rush (of the throw)’
ὕπερ: ὑπέρ — over, above; prep. + gen., accent thrown back when it stands after its noun (anastrophe): ’above’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’) · also ὡς εἰ ’as if, like’ (ὡς εἰ πτερὸν ἠὲ νόημα ’as if a wing or a thought’) · also ὡς + ἄν + opt., potential, ’as, in the way that, such as’ (ὡς οὐκ ἂν ἔλποιο ’such as you would not expect’) · also introducing a simile with the subj. and no ἄν: ’as when (a woman weeps)’ · also in an asseveration with fut. indic., ’as surely as’ (ὡς οὐκ ὀφθαλμόν γ’ ἰήσεται ’as surely as nothing will heal the eye’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. with a finite verb: ’how (dear) he is’ (ὡς ὅδε … φίλος … ἐστίν) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., of manner: ’as’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I shall say’) · also comparative ’like’, standing before its noun (ὡς νυκτερίς ’like a bat’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ὧδε: ὧδε — here, to this place, in this way; adv.
ὧραι: ὥρα — season, time of year; fem. nom. pl.
ᾗσι: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. dat. pl.: ’in his own (mind)’ (φρεσὶν ᾗσι) · also relative, fem. dat. pl.: ’for those toward whom’ (ᾗσι τ’ ἐὺ φρονέῃσι ’for those toward whom she is well disposed’)
ῥέζειν: ῥέζω — do, perform, sacrifice; pres. inf., used as an imperative
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
ῥηϊδίως: ῥηΐδιος — easy; adv. ῥηϊδίως: ’easily, readily’, epic (= Attic ῥᾳδίως)
ῥόον: ῥόος — current, stream, flow; masc. acc. sg.
